description: Log time against an issue or pull request, at least one whole second. Provide exactly one of 'seconds' or 'duration'.

created_at.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp for when the work happened (defaults to server time)

duration.description: Time as a duration string, e.g. "15m", "1h30m", "45s"; must be at least one second. Provide exactly one of seconds or duration.

index.description: Issue or pull request index (Forgejo shares index namespace between the two)

seconds.description: Time in seconds to log (whole seconds, at least one; fractions are truncated). Provide exactly one of seconds or duration.

user_name.description: Optional username to log time on behalf of (requires admin; omit for self)

name: add_issue_time
